theorem torus_proj_isCoveringMap (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    IsCoveringMap (torus_proj d L hL) :=

theorem torus_path_lift_from (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    {M : torus_E d} {y : torus_quotient d L hL}
    (γ : Path (torus_proj d L hL M) y) :
    ∃ z : torus_E d, ∃ Γ : Path M z,
      torus_proj d L hL z = y ∧
        ∀ t : unitInterval, torus_proj d L hL (Γ t) = γ t := by

theorem torus_higher_path_iff (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (g : torus_E d → ℝ) (hg : torus_isPeriodic d L g) (M : torus_E d) (P : ℝ → Prop) :
    (∃ y : torus_E d, g M < g y ∧ ∃ γ : Path M y, ∀ t : unitInterval, P (g (γ t))) ↔
      (∃ y : torus_quotient d L hL,
        torus_descend d L hL g hg (torus_proj d L hL M) < torus_descend d L hL g hg y ∧
        ∃ γ : Path (torus_proj d L hL M) y,
          ∀ t : unitInterval, P (torus_descend d L hL g hg (γ t))) := by

theorem superlevel_component_eq_iff_joinedIn {X : Type w} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (g : X → ℝ) (t : ℝ) (x y : superlevel_set g t) :
    ZerothHomotopy.mk x = ZerothHomotopy.mk y ↔
      JoinedIn (superlevel_set g t) x.val y.val := by

theorem superlevelBar_strict_cut {d : ℕ} (g : superlevelBar_E d → ℝ)
    (hg : Continuous g) (M : superlevelBar_E d)
    (hM : ¬ superlevelBar_isEssential g M) (h : ℝ) :
    h < superlevelBar_deathHeight g M ↔ h ∈ superlevelBar_clearanceSet g M := by

theorem superlevelBar_cut_unique {d : ℕ} (g : superlevelBar_E d → ℝ)
    (hg : Continuous g) (M : superlevelBar_E d)
    (hM : ¬ superlevelBar_isEssential g M) (a : ℝ)
    (ha : ∀ h : ℝ, h < a ↔ h ∈ superlevelBar_clearanceSet g M) :
    a = superlevelBar_deathHeight g M := by

theorem ordinaryH0_iso_naturality (R : C) {X Y : TopCat.{w}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    ((singularHomologyFunctor C 0).obj R).map f ≫
        (TopCat.singularHomology₀Iso Y R).hom =
      (TopCat.singularHomology₀Iso X R).hom ≫
        (ordinaryH0_componentCoproductFunctor R).map f := by

def ordinaryH0_naturalIso (R : C) :
    (singularHomologyFunctor C 0).obj R ≅ ordinaryH0_componentCoproductFunctor R :=

theorem ordinaryH0_pointClass_eq_iff (X : TopCat.{w}) (R : C)
    (hR : (𝟙 R : R ⟶ R) ≠ 0) (x y : X) :
    ordinaryH0_pointClass X R x = ordinaryH0_pointClass X R y ↔
      ZerothHomotopy.mk x = ZerothHomotopy.mk y := by

theorem ordinaryH0_filtration_difference_zero_iff_joinedIn
    {X : Type w} [TopologicalSpace X] (g : X → ℝ) (R : C)
    (hR : (𝟙 R : R ⟶ R) ≠ 0) {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (x y : superlevel_set g s) :
    (ordinaryH0_pointClass (TopCat.of (superlevel_set g s)) R x -
        ordinaryH0_pointClass (TopCat.of (superlevel_set g s)) R y) ≫
        (superlevel_h0Filtration g R).map (homOfLE hst) = 0 ↔
      JoinedIn (superlevel_set g t) x.val y.val := by
def superlevelBarField_interface (d : ℕ) (L : ℝ) : SuperlevelBarInterface d L where

theorem superlevelBarField_deathHeight_unique {d : ℕ} {L : ℝ} (I : SuperlevelBarInterface d L)
    (g : E d → ℝ) (hs : IsSmooth d g) (hp : IsLPeriodic d L g) (M : E d)
    (hM : ¬ I.IsEssential g M) :
    I.deathHeight g M = superlevelBar_deathHeight g M := by
